DT_Checkpoint9.text: CHECKPOINT 9 — Busy Stack transit entrance built from older concrete and newer municipal retrofit layers. Body-specific scanner frames, access barriers, civic decals, route signage and ordinary commuter clutter make classification feel like routine infrastructure rather than a military border. Mixed Baselines, Augments and Organics share the same circulation space but do not move through it with equal friction.

DT_Overpass.text: ELEVATED OVERPASS / CONCOURSE — Aging heavy-traffic structure layered above transit and pedestrian circulation. Exposed repair history, reinforced joints, newer composite patches over old concrete, service access and clearly readable load paths should make structural action physically understandable. The space is public and heavily used, not an abandoned industrial ruin.

DT_OversightOffice.text: OVERSIGHT OFFICE — Cleaner, colder governance-level municipal workspace: controlled access, glass partitions, orderly records, surveillance and incident feeds, restrained civic finishes and generous space compared with lower Stack workplaces. New administrative surfaces sit over older civic bones. Authority should look effortless and procedural rather than sinister.

DT_AugmentClinic.text: AUGMENT CLINIC — Busy converted parking/service-level medical and calibration workspace built into old concrete. Practical diagnostic rigs, alignment fixtures, repair benches and worn clinical equipment serve patients with visibly different qualities and costs of augmentation. Body maintenance is ordinary healthcare and class is visible in the finish, age and integration of hardware; avoid chrome cyberpunk spectacle.

DT_OrganicSafehouse.text: ORGANIC RESIDENTIAL / REPAIR SPACE — Humid inhabited service-volume neighborhood and workshop with direct infrastructure access, repair benches, shared work surfaces, personal belongings and ordinary domestic life. Organic bodies are maintained here without turning the environment into a laboratory or machinery warren. The place is culturally owned and lived in, not a hidden sewer refuge.

DT_DataCore.text: CIVIC DATA CORE — Quiet machine-native analysis environment inside the Stack's administrative infrastructure. Controlled black, white and cool luminous information surfaces, physical civic hardware and precise spatial organization support simultaneous system-scale reasoning. It should feel functional and institutional, not like a villain lair, hologram spectacle or magical cyberspace.

DT_TransitSpine.text: UNDERCITY TRANSIT / SERVICE SPINE — Layered maintenance route carrying rail, power, structural and civic systems beneath public levels. Old concrete, newer composite reinforcement, conduits, service walkways, access gates and active machinery reveal decades of accumulated construction. Geography, exits and load-bearing systems must remain visually legible during action.

DT_WhiteFacility.text: WHITE FACILITY — Immaculate unmarked controlled site embedded inside ordinary municipal infrastructure. Seamless pale surfaces, precise interfaces, concealed access and conspicuous maintenance perfection contrast with the accumulated Stack around it. Keep it bureaucratically plausible and physically real rather than futuristic mysticism.

DT_SharedDistrictRooftop.text: SHARED-DISTRICT ROOFTOP / SERVICE LEVEL — Exposed civic layer overlooking the accumulated vertical Stack: old structures, retrofits, transit arteries, residential pockets, public projections, service equipment and governance towers occupy the same skyline. Mixed-category everyday life should remain visible below the political spectacle.
